response.title: Dapagliflozin Efficacy and Action in PCOS
response.official_title: Efficacy and Safety of Dapagliflozin in Polycystic Ovary Syndrome: a Multicentre, Randomized, Placebo-controlled Trial
response.summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the efficacy and safety of dapagliflozin on improving insulin resistance and hyperandrogenemia in obesity women with polycystic ovary syndrome.

arms.label: Dapagliflozin
arms.description: Dapagliflozin (Participants will receive dapagliflozin 10mg po qd).

arms.label: Placebo
arms.description: Placebo (Participants will receive placebo po qd)

primary_outcomes.measure: Improvement in insulin resistance over 12 weeks
primary_outcomes.description: Change in insulin resistance assessed by insulin sensitivity index(HOMA-IR)

primary_outcomes.measure: Improvement in serum androgen level over 12 weeks
primary_outcomes.description: Change in androgen level assessed by free testosterone index(FAI)

secondary_outcomes.measure: Change in AUC (area under a curve) of glucose and insulin during the oral glucose tolerant test (OGTT)
Change in serum sex hormone binding globulin(SHBG)
Net change in total testosterone (TT) level
Net change in luteinzing hormone(LH) level

secondary_outcomes.description: Liver fat will be assessed by liver fibroscan.

secondary_outcomes.measure: Change in ovulation rate assessed by serum progesterone
